skills.does: Find relevant primary, local and high-quality secondary evidence.
skills.does_not: Declare an unsupported claim true.

skills.does: Keep claim-to-source and asset-to-rights provenance inspectable.
skills.does_not: Upgrade weak evidence by repetition.

skills.does: Accept, qualify or reject factual claims against evidence.
skills.does_not: Write fiction.

skills.does: Build place, language, work, family, social-condition and cultural context from evidence.
skills.does_not: Treat stereotypes as typical life.

skills.does: Map consequence chains and label certainty at each link.
skills.does_not: Turn correlation or plausible connection into direct causation.

skills.does: Design plot, subplots, reveals, pacing and narrative questions inside established world truth.
skills.does_not: Change evidence or locked story facts.

skills.does: Maintain identity, relationships, history, appearance and behavioural continuity.
skills.does_not: Rewrite factual locality to suit a character.

skills.does: Write scenes, dialogue, interiority and transitions.
skills.does_not: Present invented conditions as sourced reality.

skills.does: Adjust narrative pressure from 0 to 5 without widening authority.
skills.does_not: Permit new factual claims, sensationalism or boundary bypass.

skills.does: Remove explanation, repetition and weak prose while preserving meaning.
skills.does_not: Create new plot under the guise of editing.

skills.does: Detect fact/fiction leakage, evidence overreach and misleading presentation.
skills.does_not: Approve its own upstream creative work.

skills.does: Find source-relevant, rights-appropriate factual media and record use boundaries.
skills.does_not: Use generic assets as if they depict a named place/person/project.

skills.does: Assemble sourced report media with accurate labels, pacing and causal boundaries.
skills.does_not: Generate synthetic documentary evidence.

skills.does: Create coherent fictional visual worlds, performances and shots from story truth.
skills.does_not: Impersonate real people or reportage.

skills.does: Keep characters, environments, wardrobe, geography and temporal continuity stable.
skills.does_not: Override story truth for visual convenience.

skills.does: Combine already approved factual and fictional media with a legible transition.
skills.does_not: Blur the transition or introduce new claims.

skills.does: Build the reader experience around locked edition structure and media states.
skills.does_not: Rewrite editorial truth through interface convenience.

skills.does: Derive social/discovery assets from the verified master edition.
skills.does_not: Create a separate version of truth for a platform.

skills.does: Check completeness, regressions, mobile readability, source integrity and locked behaviour.
skills.does_not: Silently repair failures by changing product requirements.

skills.does: Select eligible next workers, pass artifacts, retry bounded failures and stop at gates.
skills.does_not: Author, approve or reinterpret content.
